text: 香港地区多家银行近期推出高利率存款产品，建银亚洲“贵宾理财”客户可享最高8.88%特惠定存年利率，新客户手机开户可享5.88%的人民币或港币定存年利率。平安数字银行符合条件的用户可开立1个月港元定期存款，最高享18%定期存款年利率。
text_en: Several banks in Hong Kong have recently launched high-interest deposit products. CCB Asia "VIP Wealth Management" customers can enjoy a special fixed deposit annual interest rate of up to 8.88%, and new customers opening accounts via mobile can enjoy a 5.88% annual interest rate on RMB or HKD fixed deposits. Eligible users of Ping An Digital Bank can open a 1-month HKD time deposit with an annual interest rate of up to 18%.
